feature: A drawn path's outline sits inside, centred or outside
summary: A closed shape drawn with the Pen now has an Align dropdown under its outline settings, as the icon drawing mock's Stroke section draws it: Inside, Center or Outside. The canvas, picture export and SVG all put the outline where you picked.
setup: Photonz Dev, release Next, no flag changed from its default. Walks: path-outline-align-walk (by name) and path-outline-align-click-walk (opens Align with a pointer click on its face).

try.do: Press P and click three points, then click the first again to close a triangle. Press V.
In Appearance, tick Outline. Thickness reads 4 and Align reads Center under Corners.
Click Align and pick Outside: the outline moves wholly past the shape's edge.
Pick Inside: the outline's outer edge lands on the path.
Draw a second closed shape, give it an outline, Shift-click both in Layers: Align reads Mixed. Pick Outside, then press Cmd-Z once: both go back together.
Draw an open path (press Return before closing it): Align reads Center, Inside and Outside are dimmed, and its tip says why.
File > Export…, choose SVG with Outside picked, and open the file in a browser: the outline sits outside there too.

evaluate: Is Align where you look for it, last under the outline settings, after Corners?
Is a dropdown right here, or would three pictures like Pattern and Corners above it read better?
On an open path, is a dimmed Inside and Outside with a tip clearer than hiding the row?
At 4pt on a big canvas the move between Center and Outside is subtle: does the default weight make the choice hard to see?
rough: Matches the mock: Align is a dropdown reading Center, in the mock's word, after the caps row.

The rest of the mock's Stroke section differs: Width is Thickness as a slider, Caps is Ends as pictures and hidden on a closed solid shape, and the settings sit under an Outline row rather than a Stroke section. Settled by task a-drawn-path-s-outline-settings-read-like-the-ic.
The app goes further than the mock with Pattern and Corners rows above Align.
Picking Inside or Outside on a mix of open and closed paths changes only the closed ones; the open ones stay centred, since a line has no inside.
